sentences: Simplicial sets describe spaces through points, edges, triangles, and their higher-dimensional analogues, making them natural models for homotopy type theory.
The source recalls a univalent simplicial model and asks how to obtain a constructive simplicial model with univalent universes.
Constructivity requires the semantic constructions to work without the classical principles used in the original account.
Cubical models provide an encouraging comparison, since a constructive treatment of univalence is available there.
Solving the simplicial problem would clarify whether the familiar simplex-based geometry can support the same constructive foundations and computational ambitions as the cubical approach.
